name: Wise Decisions
overview: Scripture teaches that wise decisions are rooted in trusting the LORD wholeheartedly rather than relying on our own understanding, as Proverbs 3:5 emphasizes. Wisdom grows through attentive listening and embracing godly counsel, demonstrated by Proverbs 1:5 and 11:14, which highlight the safety found in many advisers. Courage and confidence in decision-making come from the assurance of God's presence, as Joshua 1:9 encourages believers to be strong and unafraid because the LORD goes with them. Furthermore, humility to accept correction distinguishes the wise from the fool, who trusts only his own judgment, according to Proverbs 12:15.
